text:
elaine_marketing: ok team — kicking off a tiny micro-cohort experiment next week. Goal: nudge a first-10-run activation within 72h. Plan sketch: small starter credits ($5), 15-min live onboarding lab (2x), 2 ready-to-use prompt templates in the app, webhook-driven nudges (email + in-app), and a gated short webinar for high engagers. Test matrix: templates vs no-templates; live lab vs self-serve; immediate SDR handshake after 3 runs. pinging @sam_g for routing, @maya_k for creative, @lucas_p for metrics. thoughts? :rocket:

sam_g: inbound routing note — prefer routing rule: route to 'plg-triage' SDR queue after event 'run_prompt' count >=3 OR when average tokens/min > 50. payload: email, company, first_3_prompts, session_id. I can wire Mixpanel -> HubSpot mapping. ETA Tue morning.

maya_k: creative thumbs — I'll build two template packs: "support" + "productivity" (short, example-driven). also a 6-slide deck for the live lab. suggestion: label the incentive as "starter credits" instead of "free credits" (performed better in last subject-line test). will mock subject lines.

lucas_p: metrics POV — key metrics: 72h activation (% run >=3), 7-day DAU uplift, webinar RSVP -> conversion. I'll create cohort in Amplitude and add experiment flags. power calc incoming. shared doc: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/microhooks-cohort (placeholder).

tess_growth: webinar ops — propose two 20-min "kickstart labs" (Americas + EMEA). live build + 5-min Q. invite triggers: users with >=2 runs in 24h. RSVP tracked to segment for follow-up. internal dry run Thurs 3pm.

growth-bot: New experiment created: EXP-2026-MC01. Owners assigned: elaine_marketing, sam_g, maya_k. Sample size: 1000 users, random split 50/50. Tags: "micro-cohort", "starter-credits".

elaine_marketing: quick constraints — limit to new signups within last 30 days and <=10 seats to avoid enterprise noise. sam, can you confirm HubSpot property names? also want UTM scheme for emails.

sam_g: confirmed props: use 'plg_source' and set utm_campaign=mc-handshake-2026, utm_medium=email. I'll add mapping and check dedupe rules in HubSpot.

maya_k: I'll deliver 2 template packs + slides by Mon EOD. Copy variants to A/B test: subject A = "Start with $5 of starter credits", subject B = "Start faster: a quick spark for your first builds". Posting mockups in #marketing-assets when ready.

lucas_p: quick power calc: baseline 7-day DAU ~8%. To detect a +10% relative lift at alpha=0.05 we need ~800 per arm. Growth-bot's 1000 total works. I'll add tracking events and dashboards.

tess_growth: dry run Thurs 3pm confirmed. @everyone please add blockers by EOD Tue or I lock ops doc and schedule sends.

elaine_marketing: locking plan unless objections. thanks all :raised_hands:
